name: Itigokuruiza
source:
A go-shintai. Ren Kizirushi has been kidnapped and placed in charge of curing believers' illnesses by sharing his blood with them. Takumi Natsume, once in the same position as Ren and nicknamed "the child of the gods," is assigned to look after him. Through repeated rituals and exchanges, the two are......

translation:
Ren Kizirushi被当作“御神体”。他遭到绑架，被迫通过向信徒提供自己的血液来为他们治病。Takumi Natsume曾与Ren处境相同，被称为“神之子”，如今则受命照料他。在一次次仪式与交换中，两人逐渐……
